title: Incremental frontend modernization with portable exports
summary: React and strict TypeScript frontend with Python-owned payload contracts, portable Vite builds, authored modality filters, and reusable input/action/output teaching assets.
decision_provenance: The initial stack recommendation was by the assistant. The user subsequently accepted the refactor, retained functional parity as a constraint, authorized visual and wording refinements, and requested Python-owned type contracts and modality filtering. Specific implementation details remain assistant choices for review.
findings: The Task Explorer shares mutable selection, filter, expansion and navigation state across app.js and datasets.js. Its render path replaces the main subtree, reconnects handlers, restores focus and scroll, and disposes/remounts scenes.

Python currently copies workbench assets and emits records.json; the Task Brief builder concatenates seven scripts and embeds styles, records, source material and anatomy assets into a single HTML file.

The standalone explorer's direct file opening and embedded assets are documented contracts and covered by the existing browser harness. Default Vite application output alone does not establish parity.
The scene system uses custom Canvas2D and a WebGL surface helper, with an existing mount/cleanup boundary suitable for a React wrapper. No renderer rewrite is needed to test the UI migration.
Recent uncommitted cohesion work adds shared ui.css foundations and navigation checks. Migration should build on that work after ownership handoff.
This is a source audit, not a measured frontend performance study. No framework speed or bundle-size improvement has been established.

2026-09-24 review: the prior scene UI repeated two SVG thumbnails, a heading, controls and explanation around one model. Consolidated the walkthrough and declared the existing mask_mode, input_form and initial_candidate fields in the Python-owned contract. Reopening conditions: a scene still looks ambiguous, a source-aligned view is requested, or measured animation cost warrants a different geometry representation.

stack: React and strict TypeScript for interactive components, explicit state transitions and typed presentation payloads.
Vite for development and reproducible browser builds, with a separate tsc --noEmit gate because Vite transpilation does not type-check.
Retain shared CSS variables and existing visual foundations; introduce CSS Modules for new component-owned styles.
Use local React state/reducers and a typed hash/query URL adapter that preserves existing links. Add routing or server-state libraries only when demonstrated requirements justify them.
Retain the Playwright harness and scene checks; extend coverage for component lifecycle, data-contract compatibility and both export modes.
boundaries: JSON, TOML and Markdown records and Python validation/projection remain authoritative. Add an explicit versioned presentation payload contract with fixture checks rather than duplicating scientific status derivation in TypeScript.

Keep maintained UI source under presentation/ and Python assembly in src/tb3_medical/. Generated frontend assets stay in an owned ignored output location with a manifest and source/config/lockfile fingerprint; builders reject missing or stale compiled assets.

Produce a normal static-site build with relative asset paths and a standalone explorer build with bundled inline JavaScript, CSS and data. The standalone output must not depend on runtime module imports, fetches, remote fonts, a Node server or a SPA rewrite server.

Retain static story HTML, source attribution, conceptual-versus-evidence distinctions, reference reveals, reduced-motion behavior and missing-media states. Wrap existing scene rendering with explicit mount/update/cleanup ownership.
React adds a build dependency and runtime bytes. Prefer TypeScript modules alone if continued interactive feature development is no longer expected.
sequence: After the current frontend work is handed off, record baseline behavior and payload/build sizes. Prove one task view and one dataset route in both static-site and standalone file modes, with the existing scene renderer.
Migrate the Explorer's filters, task/variant selection, detail panels, source drawer and dataset navigation into components using the shared URL and data boundaries.
After parity is demonstrated, reuse the components in the simpler overview. Remove superseded rendering code per migrated surface; keep group stories as portable generated prose.
acceptance: Existing task, variant, source and dataset links remain usable, including browser back/forward and integrated-versus-standalone navigation.
Standalone HTML opens from disk with network access blocked and no missing assets; the integrated site works from a nested static path without server rewrites.
Keyboard focus, mobile navigation, source/reference reveals, reduced motion, scene cleanup and missing-media behavior retain coverage.
Python-generated payload fixtures satisfy the frontend contract, original evidence/status semantics remain intact, and build assets are reproducible and attributable to their source inputs.
Measure initial JavaScript and exported HTML size plus filter/detail response time against the baseline before accepting broader migration.

decisions.decision: Accepted the incremental React/TypeScript/Vite refactor and requested clearer, intuitive animations and a reusable asset home.
Keep functionality equivalent; refine wording, layout, visuals and style to be clean, elegant, informative and intuitive.
Requested a dedicated Python module for type contracts and a modality tag/filter/axis.
Requested a further visual and architectural polish of the previous Sculpted Atlas implementation, including reduction of raw JavaScript and improved maintainability.

decisions.source: Expansion request with the supplied tb3-expansion-c00e6eb handoff
decisions.decision: Expand the operation library from c00e6eb while preserving the route pilot, retained asset ownership, typed player, Three.js stage, Python DTO generation and existing exporter. Require per-entry dispositions and integrated visual/media evidence.
Selected framework, selected-story packaging and four restoration explainers as the first release; fast served catalogue plus selected offline HTML; redesign reader experience. Keep only main.
Delegated decisions on reading mode, evidence placement and authoring format to the assistant. Requested several first-slice variants, then one core design with improvement comments.

Use guided reading as the default, visible essential caveats and expandable evidence. Compare Guided, Compare and Focus as shell variants over one player and view family. Preserve explicit historical story timing; use compact family presentation definitions.
Requested an artifact governance strategy and reusable skill/scaffold preserving provenance more efficiently; welcomed deduplication.

implementation.frontend: React components for overview, task navigation/details and datasets; reducers and typed URL state replace manual full-subtree rendering.
implementation.contracts: presentation_contracts.py defines browser payload TypedDicts, validates emitted payloads and generates TypeScript; drift is checked by both Python and frontend gates.
implementation.modality: All 200 maintained entries carry explicit authored modality arrays. Taxonomy labels distinguish source/target or alternative modalities, geometry, non-image data and unspecified scope.
implementation.assets: presentation/assets/teaching owns reusable SVG art and action recipes; the existing source-derived anatomy retains its original location, hashes and notices.
implementation.build: Two local IIFE bundles and a source/output fingerprint manifest; standalone Explorer inlines browser code, CSS, payloads and teaching assets.
implementation.task_visuals: Typed React task controls and CSS Modules replace the imperative HTML-string scene player. Geometry construction, task choreography, retained anatomy, and the Three.js stage have separate TypeScript owners. This implementation choice is by the assistant; retained evidence and anatomy payloads are unchanged.

findings: Plan dispatch had to precede legacy static/spatial mode selection.
The comprehensive longitudinal candidate contract does not supply candidate locations.
Twelve supplied HiESD targets, six teaching coverage codes, and coordinate navigation have different meanings.
Source staging gaps and unfinished authoring are separate from completed operation stories.

Checkpoint: 13 of 205 entries have assistant-reviewed HTML/MP4, source-derived fallback views, before/after frames and receipts. Six original route chapter frames remain pixel-identical on this machine. 150 source/input dependencies and 42 unfinished operation reviews remain; the whole catalogue is not complete.
reopening_conditions: Resolve the per-entry source/contract blocker or finish the named pending authoring work.
Review first, decisive and ending integrated frames plus locale/mobile/no-GPU behavior before changing an entry to accepted.

findings: Live queue has 154/154 accepted core entries and 51 exclusions; 163 bound stories use 159 recipes across the full 205-entry catalogue.
Export JavaScript embeds 113974329 bytes before compression; selected-story packaging and asset injection are the first proposed migration target.
Compiler, contract, recipe dispatch, timeline and task-ID CSS repeat family-specific plumbing; retain scientific constraints while extracting reusable mechanics.

Normalize both sides of source-preview DOM comparison and repair existing browser-test formatting.
Lead scope guidance with current closeout while retaining the historical queue.
Repair low-contrast headings on dark ABRA viewer and BI-RADS panels.

artifact_retention_review_20261002.recommendation: Archive verified retired worker snapshots first; consolidate exact duplicate build inputs; migrate selected native-image packaging; share catalogue builds by exact source/build identity; add dry-run growth/retention inventory.
artifact_retention_review_20261002.preservation: Direct closeout references are a protected minimum, not a deletion allowlist. Retain exact historical accepted bytes, unsuccessful-attempt evidence, source acquisitions, notices and recovery metadata. No raw runs or freezes in scope.
artifact_retention_review_20261002.reopen_when: User selects an enumerated archive scope, packaging migration changes the asset closure, new data changes dependencies, or measured storage grows.

artifact_governance_20261002.status: implemented additive scaffold; no historical source retirement
artifact_governance_20261002.storage_contract: Original path/task/role/history identify occurrences; exact SHA-256 identifies shared gzip objects. Source and manifest checks, exclusive publication and fresh materialization preserve exact file bytes, basic modes and mtimes. No delete/GC operation.
artifact_governance_20261002.limits: Real HTML pilot is a read-only plan, not reclaimed storage. Recovery tests use temporary fixtures. Independent backup and full dependency closure are separate checks. Symlinks, empty directories, ownership/ACL/xattrs and sparse allocation are not recovered.
artifact_governance_20261002.reopen_when: User selects exact source retirement scope, a reader needs archived path resolution, or evidence justifies shared chunk storage/GC.
